buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Freshness points fairly clearly to Brancaccio. De Reales has logged 97 games across 5 matches in 14 days, Brancaccio only 33 across 2. Over the last 7 days it is 3 matches for De Reales against 1 for Brancaccio.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to De Reales on motivation and pressure. Both are gaining ground, but De Reales faster: +98 Elo over 90 days against +16 for Brancaccio. When it goes the distance, De Reales has won 73% of deciding sets over the past year to Brancaccio's 29%. Offsetting that, Brancaccio's comeback rate is 18% against 7% for De Reales, which matters if the first set slips away.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: De Reales gets a slim nod on conditions. On Clay, De Reales has won 65% over the past year (37 matches) to Brancaccio's 45% (31). De Reales has 20 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Brancaccio only 8, so the adjustment period is shorter. Offsetting that, both rate above their overall level on Clay, Brancaccio by more (+40 Elo against +14 for De Reales).
